description: Semantic Ground Truth — next build (2026-10, DRAFT, not yet run; converge waves split to one runtime target each on 2026-10-23): Databricks-branded UI (tokens, light/dark, DM Sans/Mono, assets, WCAG 2.1 AA), MCP card brand, runtime config for the executive dashboard, app secret-scope ACL fix, scheduled bronze refresh, executive AI/BI dashboard. Scoped from docs/plans/gap_analysis_2026-10.md and docs/plans/ui_brand_plan.md. Bundle-only, git-editor build; no masking. The root build (waves 0-5, sessions 01-15) shipped in PR #6 (main fbc552b); its manifest is in git history. The app bundle's own manifest (ground-truth-app/docs/plans/waves.json) is left untouched.

sessions.title: App brand foundation: tokens, theme, fonts, assets, shell
sessions.scope: ui_brand_plan sections 3-5 and 8: brand + semantic tokens in index.css (light + .dark), ThemeProvider and MotionConfig in main.tsx, self-hosted DM Sans/DM Mono, Databricks favicons/symbol, title + manifest, header/nav restyle, tokens.ts + contrast test, global focus and reduced-motion rules. No new npm dependencies.

sessions.title: Infra: app SPN secret-scope READ + scheduled bronze refresh
sessions.scope: Gap G1: grant the app service principal READ in the infra secret scope permissions via a variable (dev default = current app SPN, deploy.sh resolves it from apps get). Gap G2: hourly cdf_bronze_refresh job with a pipeline_task on the cdf_bronze pipeline (PAUSED outside prod is acceptable only if dev mode forces it; document it).

sessions.title: App MCP card brand (light + dark)
sessions.scope: Gap G9: replace inline hex in the MCP App card with CSS variables holding the ui_brand_plan semantic values, add a prefers-color-scheme dark variant, DM Sans/DM Mono font stacks, and a cardHtml unit test.

sessions.title: App runtime config, ACL safety net, verification checks
sessions.scope: GET /api/config (authenticated) returning executive_dashboard_url from env GT_EXEC_DASHBOARD_URL; app bundle variable exec_dashboard_url wired to that env; grant_app_permissions also grants the app SPN READ on the secret scope (idempotent); deploy_verification checks the scope ACL and /api/config; package.json prebuild runs vitest (gap G17).

sessions.title: Infra: executive AI/BI dashboard over the metric views
sessions.scope: Gap G3: dashboards resource in the infra bundle with a .lvdash.json over the 7 metric views (KPI counters, review activity trend, campaign progress, asset status mix, app error rate/latency), Databricks brand palette, infra warehouse.

sessions.title: Converge infra: secret ACL + bronze refresh job
sessions.scope: Deploy infra (run_setup=false) with the app SPN variable, confirm the scope ACL keeps app READ after deploy, and run cdf_bronze_refresh (which runs the cdf_bronze pipeline) cleanly with 0 failed/dropped records. Single runtime target: cdf_bronze_refresh; the gate also checks the pipeline update and the bronze table this produces. Do not work on the executive dashboard (session 22b) or the agent (session 22c).
sessions.context_notes: 2026-10-23: secrets list-acls on semantic_ground_truth_credentials showed only matthew.giglia MANAGE; app SPN 55882972-924d-42cd-ab3d-d10c730629c2 lost READ because the infra secret_scope permissions block is authoritative. Every app start logs '[ERROR] error resolving resource m2m-client-id'. bronze_lakebase_cdf last change 06:23 UTC on 2026-10-23 (manual pipeline run only).

waves.name: Converge: agent regression
gate: Session 22c status is pass with a final attempt classified stable

sessions.title: Converge agent regression: agent_verification after infra changes
sessions.scope: Regression only: run agent_verification after the infra changes in waves 2-3. This build does not change the agent bundle. If a check fails because of an infra change, fix it in ground-truth-infra; if it would need an agent edit, stop as blocked with the failing check.

waves.name: Converge: app (brand, Logic View, runtime config)
gate: Session 23 status is pass with a final attempt classified stable

sessions.title: Converge app: branded UI, runtime config, clean runtime gate
sessions.scope: Deploy the app with waves 0-1 changes and exec_dashboard_url from session 22b's summary, make the Apps build (tsc + vitest prebuild) pass, and keep the runtime gate clean: zero ERROR/FATAL or level=error/fatal lines, all probes passing. Single runtime target: app. After the final stable deploy, run deploy_verification once (bundle run deploy_verification) because the wave gate also checks app_deploy_verification for a successful run started during this build.
sessions.context_notes: 2026-10-23 baseline: deploy_verification 6/6 (run 92578084705794); graceful shutdown logs 'Shutdown complete' in 5 ms; app.yaml runs node directly. The m2m-client-id ERROR at start must be gone once wave 2 restores the scope ACL; if it is not, stop as blocked rather than suppressing the log.
